forbids: catastrophizing or false-confidence vocabulary in any board-facing renderer
note: Enrolled in v0.60.0. Guard-shaped since it was written and classified `candidate` by BL-101's registry, which is how it became countable. BL-121 was the blocker: 51 checks across these nine suites read a crashed probe as a pass, so a mutation registered here would have been registered against a check that could not fail. That closed in v0.59.0.

mutations.why: A sentence of catastrophizing prose added to a shipped renderer. This is the way in that matters: nobody writes `catastrophic` into a board pack on purpose, they write it into a helper's default string and it reaches the page months later. The mutation is a module-level constant rather than an edit to live output, so it proves the SOURCE scan specifically — the half that exists because a string can ship without ever being rendered in the fixture.
defeats: no confidence vocabulary in the source of any board-facing view
